name: whisper-malagasy-medium
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-medium (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of openai/whisper-medium, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.764 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence agpl-3.0, repo created 2026-02-16. CAVEAT: the base column is a printed bound ('>80%'), not a measured point estimate, so the 20.78-vs-80 gap is not a like-for-like delta. The card itself marks this repo obsolete in favour of Flo976/w2v-bert-malagasy (13.1% on normalised long extracts, 5x faster).

benchmarks.name: WER, badrex/malagasy-speech-full validation
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Modele | WER (validation) |': 'openai/whisper-medium (vanilla)' printed as '>80%' (a BOUND, not a measured point estimate - card: le malagasy n'est pas supporte) vs this model 20.78%. Headline 20.78% was computed on raw text with punctuation/case counted as errors; the card's own re-measurement on normalised text gives 13.1% on long test extracts. Card marks this repo OBSOLETE in favour of Flo976/w2v-bert-malagasy.
